name: Bank of Maharashtra
summary: Bank of Maharashtra provides various banking products and services in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company accepts savings, current, term, and recurring deposits, as well as provides capital gain account schemes. It also offers housing loans, vehicle and car loans, topup loans, education loans, gold loans, personal loans, salary gain schemes, green financing schemes, rooftop solar panel loans, and adhaar loans, as well as loans against properties and deposits; working capital, term, project, infrastructure, export, and bill financing services; lines of credit; commercial lease rental services; acc…
